settings.appearance_meta: Changes apply right away and stay on this computer.
settings.window_hint: How much of the desktop shows through.
settings.glow_hint: The keyboard focus ring never fully goes away.
settings.accent_hint: Focus rings, links and the main button.
settings.ui_font_hint: Any font installed on this computer.
settings.language_hint: Messages from the server stay in English.

apps.connect_first: Choose a saved server or enter its SSH target in the sidebar.
apps.title: Applications
apps.subtitle: Source, deployments and configuration in one place.
apps.empty_body: Create a definition, review its settings, then deploy a branch or commit.
apps.build_status_note: Build status describes the image. The active traffic release is shown separately.
apps.no_releases: No releases yet. Deploy to create the first one.
apps.delete_unknown: Deletion is disabled because this server does not report the active release.
apps.delete_live: Deletion is disabled while a release is serving traffic.
apps.delete_scope: Removes the definition, release records and containers. Named volume data remains on disk.
form.env_hint: One NAME=value per line. Values are visible on the host; do not enter secrets.
form.volumes_hint: One name=/container/path per line. Append :ro for read-only access.
form.volumes_scope: Volumes are shared between releases. Deployment and rollback do not reverse application data or database migrations.
form.create_scope: Creates a definition only. Building and starting the application require a separate deployment.
form.update_scope: Domain changes apply immediately when traffic is available. Branch, health, replicas, environment and volume bindings apply on the next deployment. Removed volume bindings keep their data on disk.
form.invalid_id: Use 1–32 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens; start with a letter.
form.invalid_source: Enter a host name, repository owner, repository name and a nonempty branch. URLs and credentials are not accepted.
form.invalid_port: Container port must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
form.invalid_replicas: Replicas must be a whole number from 1 to 64.
form.invalid_limits: Memory must be at least 6 MiB, CPU at least 10 milliseconds, and disk weight from 10 to 1000.
form.invalid_dockerfile: Dockerfile must be a relative repository path without parent-directory traversal.
form.invalid_domain: Enter a domain name without a scheme, port or path.
form.invalid_health: Health check path must start with / and contain no whitespace.
form.invalid_env: Use unique NAME=value entries with valid variable names.
form.invalid_volumes: Use unique volume names and clean absolute container paths. Root, system paths and overlapping mounts are not accepted.
operation.deploy_body: Builds a release and moves traffic only after the health gate passes. Existing volume data is shared.
operation.rollback_body: Moves traffic to the previous activation from server history. Application data and migrations stay as they are.
operation.delete_body: Deletes the definition and release history, and removes its containers. Named volumes stay on disk.
operation.ref: Branch, tag or full commit SHA
operation.review_hint: The server will validate this request before changing anything.
operation.no_success: Deployment ended without a confirmed release and image.
operation.recreated: Containers were recreated from the retained image.
logs.snapshot: Bounded snapshot of the active deployment logs. Refresh to read new output.
logs.truncated: Output reached the size limit and was truncated.
alarms.title: Alarms
alarms.subtitle: Current conditions reported by this server.
alarms.local_only: Alarms are local to this server. External notifications are not delivered.
backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: Snapshots of the Kadran control database on this server.
backups.volumes_excluded: Scope: Kadran control database only. Application volumes, application databases and images are excluded.
backups.restore_help: Recovery is a server maintenance operation. Follow docs/guides/operations.md for stopping services, restoring control data and backing up volumes consistently.
setup.title: Connect your first server
setup.body: Kadran connects through your existing SSH identity. Enter user@host in the sidebar when the server is ready.
setup.server_body: Install Kadran on the Linux server and authorize your public key for the configured client account. Follow the installation guide in README and the upgrade guide in docs/guides/quality-upgrade.md.
setup.ssh_body: Your computer needs the OpenSSH client. SSH config aliases are accepted as targets, as are user@host names.
setup.key_title: Use your SSH key or agent
setup.key_body: Choose the identity in your SSH config or load it into ssh-agent. Keep private keys and passphrases in SSH tooling.
setup.trust_body: Before using Kadran, connect once with OpenSSH and compare the host fingerprint through a trusted channel. Host trust must already be recorded in known_hosts.
setup.error_help: Connection failures preserve the full SSH message. Check the target, reachability, host trust and authorized public key against that message.
setup.compact_help: Install Kadran on the server. Use OpenSSH with your SSH config or agent, verify the host fingerprint once, then connect here.
chains.stale: The previous verification is out of date; verify again.
form.env_preserved: Existing values are hidden by the server and preserved. Enter only values you intend to replace; NAME= explicitly sets an empty value.
form.env_remove_hint: One existing name per line. A missing replacement does not remove an existing variable.
form.invalid_env_remove: Use unique variable names to remove; do not also replace the same name.
operation.deleted: Deleted {app}: {containers} containers, {releases} releases and {deployments} activation records removed.
